14.-23.0.rawDesc:
As you start westward on a barely noticeable trail, the trees grow closer
together, their spreading canopy blocking out most of the light from the sun
on even a good day.  This particular forest looks to be sorely in need of a
green thumb, with the browns and grays of decay extending on the ground as
far as the eye can see.  Roaming amongst the detritus are various creatures.


A stone archway lies to the south, where a large decrepit temple looms over
the landscape.  The smell of rotting flesh is strong here.
